CustomField.description: Text field storing a banner image reference (file/document id or path) for the section. Not consumed by the current formTemplatePageSection render path; Form_Banner_Image_URL__c is a formula derived from it. Legacy/optional banner storage - leave blank unless a custom configuration consumes it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional stored reference for a section banner image. Most templates leave this blank; the displayed URL is derived from it in the Form Banner Image URL field.
CustomField.label: Form Banner Image
